content:
leo: Heads up — after last night's KMS key rollout for disk encryption, two autoscaling groups failed to bootstrap in us-west-2. Instances hit a decrypt error and never finished cloud-init.

nina: saw the alerts. error was `Failed to decrypt volume: InvalidCiphertextException` in the instance boot logs.

ashish: timeline? which key was rotated?

leo: sec_ops rotated alias `alias/redwood-disk-enc` -> new key (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/NEWKEY). They also changed the key policy to require `kms:Decrypt` from a service role — looks like the instance profile used the old principal.

maria: oh, so node IAM role couldn't decrypt the EBS volume at attach time.

ops-oncall: cluster nodes stuck in provisioning loop. I brought one up manually and attached root volume to a worker — saw cloud-init trying to call `aws kms decrypt` via the instance-role, denied.

sec_ops_bot: automated change flagged: KMS key rotation and key policy update completed @2026-02-16T03:12Z. Change ticket #INFRA-4521.

ashish: quick mitigation: add a temporary statement to the new key policy allowing the old instance profile principal to `kms:Decrypt` for 1 hour, then do the proper IAM update.

nina: we should avoid long-lived dual-key policies. can we instead update the instance profile to include the new key arn in `kms:Decrypt` permissions? that's the intended fix.

leo: agreed. but rolling config to thousands of nodes will take time. mitigation buys time for graceful node replacement.

maria: proposed policy snippet (terraform):
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "redwood_disk" {
  key_id = "NEWKEY"
}

resource "aws_kms_key_policy" "temp_allow_old_role" {
  policy = <<POL
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowOldInstanceProfileDecrypt",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123:role/old-instance-profile"},
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
POL
}
```

ops-oncall: if we add that, can you scope it to specific CMKs and set expiration via automation? want to avoid forgetting to remove.

sec_ops_bot: suggested TTL automation: `infra-scripts/key-policy-ttl` will remove statement after 1h if tag `temp-allow=true` present.

ashish: sounds good. also need to re-run ASG rolling update with `--force-new-instances` after the IAM role is patched to include access to `NEWKEY`.

nina: one more catch — CloudTrail / audit logs for these key policy changes are landing in a bucket in eu-central-1. We did cross-region delivery this quarter. The logs for the rotation are incurring inter-region replication costs and Glacier lifecycle is different.

maria: can someone estimate added monthly cost for cross-region CloudTrail delivery + lifecycle?

leo: rough calc: ~120GB of management events/day * 30 = 3.6TB/month. Replication egress to eu ~ $0.09/GB => ~$324/mo egress, plus new storage location rates. with 90-day hot retention that's bigger. If we shorten management-trail retention to 30 days in hot bucket and archive after, we can save ~60%.

ops-oncall: but compliance team requires 1-year retention for audit logs. We can keep a compressed, archived copy in cold storage (Glacier Deep Archive) after 30 days. That meets compliance and saves cost.

sec_ops_bot: compliance note: archive-only retention must still be immutable and accessible for e-discovery within 48h. our current replication workflow meets immutability via bucket lock.

maria: let's formalize: immediate actions — (1) apply temp key-policy allowing old instance-profile decrypt, TTL 1h automation (ashish), (2) patch instance-profile IAM to include `kms:Decrypt` for NEWKEY and rollout ASG (nina + ops-oncall), (3) schedule CloudTrail retention change to 30-day hot -> archive policy and enable cross-region replication lifecycle to Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days (leo + finance).

ashish: I'll push the temp policy now and tag it `temp-allow=true`.

leo: do it in canary group first (two ASGs), confirm nodes come up, then expand.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: asg/redwood-workers-canary -> 2 instances replacing (triggered by ashish).

ops-oncall: canary succeeded — nodes came up and joined cluster, no decrypt errors on new instances.

nina: started IAM patch job. will update once 20% ASGs rolled.

maria: finance — FYI cost estimate and proposed retention change: need sign-off for archival lifecycle.

leo: follow-up: add an infra postmortem note and a runbook entry that KMS key rotations MUST include a gradual IAM role update plan and pre-created key-policy statements for old principals to reduce blast radius.

ashish: logged follow-up task #INFRA-4524: `key-rotation-runbook` and assigned to nina.

ops-oncall: any objections to closing this thread once IAM patch complete and CloudTrail lifecycle scheduled?

maria: none. thanks all. :thumbsup:
